vintage: Eurostat structural business statistics by NUTS 2 region (sbs_r_nuts2021), latest year

rule.text: A district appears when its industries together employ at least 1.25× the EU share of jobs (location quotient) and at least 1,000 people or 1% of the metro’s jobs, or when one of its specialities reaches 3× the EU share with at least 1,000 jobs. Districts are ranked by jobs above the EU norm; up to 5. A Port District needs a footprint hex on or next to water. Jobs come from Eurostat structural business statistics (persons employed in local units, by NUTS 2 region): a metro gets its NUTS 2 regions’ jobs in proportion to the share of their population that lives in the metro, so metros inside one NUTS 2 region share one profile.
rule.county_note: Not computed for NUTS 3 regions: the source is published for NUTS 2 regions only.
